say:3:1041203001:1.text: I didn't expect our reunion to happen in such circumstances...

say:9:1041203006:1.text: I knoweth only of Captain Parisa's graduation from the Jade Lake Academy; the tales of Lyca and Eironn remain a mystery unto me!

say:10:1041203007:1.text: The Thorned Faction has always been exclusive, so Kafra's limited knowledge about Lyca and Eironn is quite expected.
say:10:1041203007:1.source_cn: 荆棘素来排外，所以卡夫拉对莱卡和埃隆了解不深，这很正常。

say:11:1041203008:1.text: Ultimately, it's because of the strict Thorned Guards' discipline that Lyca and I rarely got the chance to meet.
say:11:1041203008:1.source_cn: 归根究底，也是因为荆棘纪律森严，我和莱卡才难得见上一面。

say:12:1041203009:1.text: True, who would have thought you'd join the Thorned Guards right after graduation?
say:12:1041203009:1.source_cn: 是啊，谁想得到，你一毕业就加入了荆棘卫队。

say:13:1041203010:1.text: Honestly, I was quite envious of you at that time.
say:13:1041203010:1.source_cn: 老实说，那时候我还很羡慕你呢。

say:15:1041203012:1.text: Not only do you possess extraordinary magical talents, but you also gained the recognition of a sage just after graduating. Anyone would envy that, wouldn't they?

say:20:1041203016:1.text: There's nothing to be envious of. My life during that time wasn't a breeze either.
